subject: Anchored platform fee + one-time migration credit and SLA options
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orchidhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment commercial ask — migration credit and SLA breaks

Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo and the detailed runbook. Our execs are broadly happy with the solution but procurement needs a clearer commercial anchor before we move to legal. Two asks from our side: 

1) Platform fee amortization: we prefer to anchor platform fee as a fixed amortized amount over 24 months (vs. upfront platform fee). Can you show a 24mo amortized schedule and what that looks like at 12/24/36 node profiles?

2) Migration credit: given our expected 6-week integration effort, can Redwood provide a one-time migration credit to offset professional services or an implementation retainer? We were thinking $75k as a target number but are flexible based on scope.

Also, SLA trade-offs: we can accept a standard 99.5% uptime SLA if you can include a response-time on-call retainer (SRE hours) for P0s during the initial 12 months.

Can you share a worked pricing scenario and a short SOW stub we can circulate internally? Ideally by EOD Tuesday so we can prep for internal vendor comparison next week.

Appreciate it — Samantha
Samantha Li
Director, Procurement
Orchid Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commercial ask — migration credit and SLA breaks

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear asks. We're happy to put together the scenario and the SOW stub. Quick summary of what we'll include: 

- 24-month amortization schedule for the platform fee across 3 node profiles (Starter/Standard/Enterprise). We'll show equivalent net effective monthly costs and a comparison to an upfront platform fee.
- Migration credit options: (A) $75k one-time credit applied to the first invoice; (B) $50k credit + 40 SRE hours (redwood on-call) over first 3 months; (C) no credit but discounted implementation hourly rate.
- SLA + on-call tradeoffs: standard 99.5% SLA + optional 24x7 on-call retainer (price per month) vs premium 99.9% SLA with 8x5 on-call included. We'll call out response SLAs for P0/P1/P2 and how credits apply for any SLA misses.

I'm CC'ing Marissa to model the price scenarios and Irene for SOW language and legal bullets we should surface. We aim to get the XLS and SOW to you by tomorrow EOD.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing model inputs (work in progress)

Naomi / Irene —

Drafted three amortization scenarios in the attached XLS: Starter (2 nodes), Standard (6 nodes), Enterprise (20 nodes). Assumptions: core platform fee is $1.2M list for Starter (24mo), $2.8M for Standard, $5.6M for Enterprise. Amortized monthly = platform_fee / 24. I also included an effective per-token delta for the caching/batching improvements we expect after KV cache tuning (conservative estimates).

Migration credit treatment options included:
- Option A: $75k cash credit on first invoice (preferred by buyer).
- Option B: $50k credit + 40 hours SRE (at no additional charge) during first 90 days — value assigned at $225/hr.
- Option C: No credit, reduced PS hourly rate (20% off).

SLA constructs:
- Standard: 99.5% uptime, P0 response within 2 hours, 8x5 on-call retainer available at $12k/mo.
- Premium: 99.9% uptime, P0 response 30 mins, 24x7 on-call retainer included in price for the first 12 months (adds ~12% to amortized fee).

Irene — added some legal caveats in comments about credit application and invoicing cadence. Naomi — let me know which combination you want to propose.

Attachments: orchid-pricing-scenario-v2.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing model inputs (work in progress)

Quick legal flags for external: 
- If we offer $75k credit, request it applied as a one-time invoice credit against the first 90 days; ensure contract language ties credit to completion of implementation milestones (kickoff + acceptance).
- For SRE hours we need a consumption and rollover policy (unused hours expire after 90 days).
- SLA credits: standard 99.5% -> penalty cap should be limited to a percentage of monthly amortized fee; avoid large lump-sum exposures.

I suggest we propose Option B (50k + 40 SRE hours) as our primary because it reduces cash concession but demonstrates operational commitment. Secondary offer Option A if they push. Naomi — I'll draft the SOW stub and include the milestone language and credit application.

Irene
General Counsel (contracts counsel) — Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing scenarios and SOW stub for Orchid Health (DL-9873-ORCHID)

Samantha —

Thanks for the patience. Attached are two artifacts: (1) orchid-pricing-scenario-v2.xlsx — three amortization scenarios (Starter/Standard/Enterprise) with equivalent monthly amortized platform fees and the per-node cost delta; (2) privdeploy-sow-draft.pdf — high level SOW and milestone-based application of credits.

Commercial summary (proposal):
- Primary commercial offer (Option B): $50,000 one-time migration credit + 40 SRE hours (no charge) applied during the first 90 days; platform fee amortized over 24 months at the Starter/Standard/Enterprise bands shown in the XLS.
- SLA: Standard 99.5% uptime with P0 response within 2 hours. For the first 12 months, the 40 SRE hours are included as a proactive on-call retainer (not for unlimited emergency coverage).
- Alternate (if you need higher cash credit): $75,000 one-time invoice credit (Option A) in lieu of SRE hours.

Next steps: please confirm which node profile you're targeting (Starter/Standard/Enterprise) and whether you prefer Option A or Option B. If this looks good I can loop in our legal team to start redlines against the SOW/TSAs.

Doc links: https://hubspot.example/deals/DL-9873-ORCHID

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
